title: Factory / Plant Head - Precast
description:
Greetings from Eco Chimneys Pvt. Ltd. 
 We are looking for an experienced Factory / Plant Head to lead our RCC Precast Chimney Manufacturing Plant at Bavla, Ahmedabad. 
 Company: Eco Chimneys Pvt. Ltd. Website: https://ecochimneys.com/ 
 Position: Factory / Plant Head Location: Bavla, Ahmedabad, Gujarat Experience: 10+ Years preferred Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/Diploma Civil Industry Preference: RCC Chimney / Precast Concrete / Heavy Concrete / Civil Construction Immediate Joiners: Preferred 
 Key Responsibilities Factory / Plant Head Take complete responsibility for overall plant operations, production, quality, safety, maintenance, manpower, and timely dispatch. Plan and achieve production targets in line with project requirements and delivery schedules. Lead the complete manufacturing process of RCC precast chimney components, including mould preparation, reinforcement, concrete batching, casting, vibration, curing, demoulding, finishing, inspection, and stacking. Ensure production is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, and project requirements. Manage and optimize manpower, machinery, moulds, materials, utilities, and plant resources. Monitor plant productivity, production cycle time, material consumption, wastage, rejection/rework, equipment downtime, and overall operating efficiency. Drive cost reduction, productivity improvement, process optimization, and reduction of material wastage. Coordinate with Project, Planning, QA/QC, Procurement, Stores, Maintenance, Safety, and Dispatch teams. Ensure proper preventive maintenance and maximum availability of plant machinery and equipment. Establish and maintain strong quality control systems for reinforcement, concrete, dimensions, surface finish, curing, and finished components. Ensure strict compliance with plant safety procedures, PPE requirements, lifting practices, and statutory safety standards. Lead, train, and develop the production and plant workforce to build a disciplined and productive team. Review daily/weekly/monthly plant performance and submit MIS/DPR and management reports. Ensure optimum utilization of plant capacity and timely completion of production commitments. Take corrective and preventive actions for production, quality, manpower, machinery, and operational issues. Maintain overall plant discipline, operational efficiency, cost control, and continuous improvement. Candidates with experience handling complete plant operations and large production teams will be preferred. 
 Interested candidates may share their updated resume at: Abhil Krishna HR Executive Eco Chimneys Pvt. Ltd. 99944 61358 abhilkrishna@ecochimneys.com

title: Assistant Manager Logistics (Chemicals)
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Job Summary/ Objective: The Sr. Engineer/ Assistant Manager Logistics (Chemicals) will be responsible for end-to-end International and Domestic Logistics of hazardous and non-hazardous Chemicals required for Semiconductor Manufacturing. The role will cover planning and execution of Import/ Export and Domestic movements, Bulk and Packaged Chemicals, Tankers/ ISO Tanks/ Containers/ Drums/ IBCs and other approved packaging, Warehousing/ Storage interfaces, Returnable Packaging/ Containers and Reverse Logistics. The position will coordinate with Suppliers, Procurement, Projects, Facilities/ Utilities, Manufacturing, EHS, Finance, Stores/ Warehouse, Customs & Trade Compliance and 3PL/ 4PL Logistics Service Providers including Customs House Agents (CHA), Freight Forwarders, Transporters, DGFT Consultants and Trade/ Regulatory Consultants to ensure safe, compliant, timely and cost-effective material movement. For Chemicals Logistics: The role will primarily focus on logistics of hazardous/ specialty chemicals in Liquid, Solid and other applicable forms, including Bulk and Packaged Chemicals, Tanker/ ISO Tank/ Container movements, compliant storage interfaces, SDS-based handling requirements, Dangerous Goods documentation, waste/ residue interfaces and Reverse Logistics. The candidate shall possess strong awareness of material classification and documentation including applicable HS/ HTS Classification, UN Number, CAS Number, SDS, Hazard Class, Packaging/ Labelling and Dangerous Goods transportation requirements. Working knowledge of applicable Customs, DGFT, PESO, Pollution Control Board, BIS/ QCO, IATA DGR, IMDG and other relevant regulatory/ safety requirements will be preferred. Execute/ manage end-to-end International and Domestic Logistics for Chemicals required for Semiconductor Manufacturing, covering Import, Export, Domestic Transportation, Storage/ Warehousing interface and Reverse Logistics. Plan and coordinate logistics from Global and Domestic Suppliers through Air, Sea, Road and applicable Multimodal Transportation while ensuring compliance with product-specific safety and statutory requirements. Coordinate with 3PL/ 4PL Logistics Service Providers including CHA, Freight Forwarders, Hazardous/ Dangerous Goods Transporters, Tanker/ ISO Tank/ Dangerous Goods Logistics operators, DGFT Consultants and Trade/ Regulatory Consultants. Review and maintain complete Logistics and Dangerous Goods Documentation including Commercial Invoice, Packing List, SDS, applicable Dangerous Goods Declaration, Transport Documents, Certificates, Permits/ Licences, applicable UN/ Hazard Classification, Product Identification and shipment supporting documents. Possess working knowledge of Indian Import/ Export regulations and applicable requirements of Customs, DGFT, PESO, Pollution Control Board, BIS/ QCO and transportation/ storage requirements governing Chemicals, Gases and Hazardous Materials. Ensure Logistics Service Providers follow applicable Safety, Packaging, Labelling, Vehicle/ Equipment, PPE, Emergency Response and Material Handling requirements in coordination with EHS and relevant SMEs. Coordinate Warehouse/ Stores/ Chemical Storage/ Warehouse interfaces, material receipt, delivery scheduling, Tanker/ ISO Tank/ Container receipt and dispatch, unloading/ handover coordination, inventory-document reconciliation and discrepancy/ damage reporting. Coordinate Reverse Logistics of empty Containers, ISO Tanks, Tankers, Drums/ IBCs and other Returnable Transport/ Packaging assets, as applicable to the material. Maintain Daily Shipment Report (DSR), Shipment Trackers, Logistics Master Data, Document Repositories, Freight/ Logistics Cost Data, Demurrage/ Detention data and KPI/ MIS reports. Use Advanced MS Excel for shipment tracking, data reconciliation, Lookups, PivotTables, ageing/ exception analysis, KPI reporting and management MIS. Power Query exposure will be an added advantage. Analyse Logistics KPIs, transportation constraints, delays, operational risks and cost improvement opportunities and drive/ support corrective actions with relevant stakeholders. Work cross-functionally with Procurement, Projects, Facilities/ Utilities, Manufacturing, EHS, Finance, Stores/ Warehouse, Customs & Trade Compliance, Security and external Logistics partners. Maintain high standards of documentation accuracy, regulatory compliance, audit readiness and adherence to Logistics SOPs/ Work Instructions/ Checklists. For Sr. Engineer/ Assistant Manager Logistics (Chemicals): Hands-on exposure to logistics of Specialty/ Industrial/ Hazardous Chemicals in Liquid, Solid and applicable Bulk/ Packaged forms. Practical knowledge of Chemical Logistics through Tankers, ISO Tanks, Containers, Drums/ IBCs/ approved packaging and other suitable transportation modes. Ability to understand SDS and key logistics-related material information including Product Classification, UN Number, CAS Number, Hazard Class, Packing Group where applicable, compatibility and transportation/ storage precautions. Working knowledge of packaging, labelling, segregation, transportation and storage requirements applicable to hazardous/ dangerous Chemicals. Experience coordinating Chemical Storage/ Warehouse interfaces, unloading/ receipt readiness, container/ tanker turnaround and Returnable Packaging/ Reverse Logistics. Awareness of handling requirements for empty/ used Chemical Containers/ Tanks and coordination of decontamination/ waste-related interfaces with EHS and authorized specialist service providers, wherever applicable. Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering/ Chemical Technology/ Petrochemical Engineering/ Industrial Chemistry/ Chemistry/ Applied Chemistry/ Science or other relevant technical discipline from a recognized institution. Candidates possessing a relevant Master's Degree in Engineering/ Chemistry/ Science/ Management will have an added advantage. PG Certificate/ Diploma/ Degree in Export-Import Management, Shipping Management, Logistics or Supply Chain Management will be preferred/ considered an added advantage. Valid IATA DGR/ Dangerous Goods Certification appropriate to the job function will be strongly preferred; candidates with relevant experience and willingness to obtain/ maintain required certification may also be considered. Relevant Hazardous Chemical Safety/ SDS/ Dangerous Goods Classification/ Transportation/ Emergency Response training. Preferred candidate profile 
 Sr. Engineer (C-2): Preferably 4 – 6 years of relevant hands-on experience in Chemicals Logistics, Dangerous Goods Logistics, International/ Domestic Logistics, Import-Export, Transportation, Warehousing and Supply Chain Operations. Assistant Manager (C-3): Preferably 6 – 10 years of relevant experience in Chemicals Logistics with demonstrated ownership of Logistics execution, LSP management, regulatory-compliance coordination, operational risk management, Logistics MIS/ KPIs and process improvement. Final designation/ grade may be determined based on the candidate's overall relevant experience, functional depth and organizational fit. Preferred Industry Experience: Candidates having relevant Logistics/ Supply Chain experience from the following industries will be preferred: Semiconductor/ Electronics Manufacturing/ Semiconductor Fab or associated supply chain. Specialty Chemicals/ Electronic-grade Chemicals/ High-purity Chemicals. Chemical/ Petrochemical Manufacturing. Pharmaceutical/ High-Purity Process Industries involving controlled hazardous-material logistics. EPC/ Greenfield Manufacturing Projects having significant Chemical Logistics scope. Specialized 3PL/ 4PL, Freight Forwarding or Dangerous Goods Logistics organizations handling Chemicals. Semiconductor Industry experience will be preferred but should not be mandatory, provided the candidate has strong Chemical Logistics, Dangerous Goods, Compliance and Manufacturing-sector experience. Chemicals Logistics Candidate - Preferred Experience: Specialty/ Industrial/ Hazardous Chemical Logistics. Chemical import/ export and domestic distribution. Bulk tanker/ ISO Tank and packaged Chemical movements. DG documentation and SDS interpretation. UN/ CAS/ Hazard Classification awareness. Chemical warehousing/ storage interfaces. Customs/ DGFT/ PESO/ PCB/ relevant regulatory coordination. Dangerous Goods transportation. Returnable packaging, empty container/ tank movement and Reverse Logistics. 3PL/ CHA/ Freight Forwarder/ Transporter management. Logistics MIS, KPI and Advanced Excel. Experience in Semiconductor/ Electronic-grade Chemicals will be a significant advantage. IT/ Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in MS Excel including Lookups, Pivot Tables, Data Reconciliation, Data Analysis, Exception/ Ageing Analysis and KPI Reporting. Working knowledge of MS Office and ERP systems such as SAP/ SAP S/4HANA/ SAP MM. Exposure to Power Query, TMS, Warehouse Management or Logistics/ Trade Compliance systems will be an added advantage.

About Bacancy Systems Bacancy Systems is a product-focused company developing innovative solutions across EV technology, power electronics, energy, and smart hardware. 
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced EMI/EMC Testing & Validation Engineer to perform electromagnetic compatibility testing, product validation, troubleshooting, and compliance activities for electronic and power-electronics products. The candidate will work closely with hardware, firmware, and system engineering teams to identify issues and ensure product reliability and compliance with applicable standards. 
 Key Responsibilities Perform EMI/EMC testing and validation , including conducted and radiated emissions and immunity testing. Conduct ESD, electrical fast transient (EFT), surge, and other applicable immunity tests. Support EMI/EMC testing for products such as EV chargers, solar/hybrid inverters, energy storage systems (ESS), and industrial power supplies . Set up test configurations, operate laboratory equipment, record results, and prepare detailed test reports. Analyze test failures and perform root cause analysis to identify electromagnetic interference issues. Work with hardware and design teams to implement corrective actions, including filtering, grounding, shielding, cable routing, and PCB-related improvements. Validate products against applicable EMI/EMC standards and customer requirements. Coordinate with external testing laboratories and certification agencies, wherever required. Maintain test plans, validation records, technical documentation, and compliance reports. Support product development from prototype testing through design validation and certification. Required Skills & Qualifications B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, ECE, or Power Electronics. Hands-on experience in EMI/EMC testing, validation, or compliance . Understanding of conducted and radiated emissions, immunity testing, ESD, EFT, and surge. Familiarity with standards such as IEC 61000 and CISPR , depending on product requirements. Experience using equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, EMI receivers, LISNs, and EMC test setups. Knowledge of grounding, shielding, filtering, and electromagnetic interference troubleshooting. Ability to analyze test results, identify failures, and coordinate corrective actions. Good analytical, documentation, and cross-functional communication skills.

title: Enterprise Integration and Data Architecture Professional
description:
Job Overview The Senior Manager - Enterprise Integration Data Architecture is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining NetSuite integrations, APIs, EDI connections, and data pipelines. The role ensures reliable data exchange, data integrity, and secure connectivity across enterprise systems while supporting distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. It also focuses on data governance, legacy system migration, integration monitoring, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership to build scalable and efficient business solutions. Duties Responsibilities Design and maintain enterprise integration architecture for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events and batch processing. Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, sequencing, validation, error handling, retries, reconciliation, security and support ownership. Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records and runbooks. Design, build, test, deploy and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems. Work with NetSuite REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect and token-based authentication, as applicable. Support EDI and API connectivity with customers, distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services and websites. Develop mappings and workflows for purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing and order status. Establish enterprise data architecture, data ownership, stewardship, quality rules and lifecycle requirements. Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions and reconciliation processes. Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files and automated jobs to identify business rules and technical dependencies. Support data extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation and reconciliation. Support NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted. Design trusted data models and pipelines for reporting and ensure they reconcile to source transactions. Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover and reconciliation tests. Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms and escalation procedures. Troubleshoot production issues and perform root-cause analysis across systems, data, networks, authentication and business rules. Apply security and data protection standards, including source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment and change control. Own integration standards, data pipelines, technical documentation and long-term architecture improvements. Work with implementation partners, build internal support capability and prioritize technical debt and enhancements. Develop scalable integration patterns that support growth, acquisitions, customer and vendor onboarding, analytics and automation. Education Training The JD does not specify a mandatory degree or formal educational qualification. It requires more than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering or related technical experience, along with meaningful hands-on NetSuite integration experience. Candidates should have experience designing, building, testing, deploying and supporting production integrations and data pipelines. Experience with a full range of integration technologies and data migration processes is important. Preferred experience includes Oracle Integration Cloud, NetSuite integration technologies, EDI, cloud data platforms and legacy application modernization. Knowledge, Skills Experience More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering or related technical experience. Hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite records, transactions, permissions, APIs or scripting capabilities. Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication and modern integration patterns. Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring and supporting production integrations and data pipelines. Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data and data-quality controls. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security and business processes. Knowledge of API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management and operational documentation. Understanding of order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment and accounting impacts. Ability to assess and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and take ownership of technical designs. Strong written communication skills and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operations. Preferred: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, NetSuite Analytics Warehouse, EDI standards, food or wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, Microsoft Dynamics GP modernization, Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, document processing, multi-entity environments and acquisition integrations. title: Deputy General Manager - Smart Campus
description:
Job Description 
 Deputy General Manager (DGM) Smart Campus 
 Department Digital Technology Reports To Chief Digital Officer Location Ahmedabad, Gujarat Employment Type Full-Time 
 Role Summary
The DGM Smart Campus will lead the strategy, design, and execution of Smart Campus IT infrastructure across the organization's campus locations. This role owns the end-to-end lifecycle of smart campus technologies from strategic planning and vendor selection through deployment, integration, and operations spanning IoT device ecosystems, data center build-outs, network infrastructure, and campus-wide digital systems. The ideal candidate combines strong technical infrastructure expertise with proven program leadership and stakeholder management skills.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy & Planning
 Define and drive the long-term Smart Campus technology roadmap aligned with organizational goals (sustainability, safety, efficiency, user experience).
 Define & design architectures aligned with organizational goals covering the smart campus roadmap
 Evaluate emerging technologies (IoT, edge computing, AI-enabled building systems, 5G/Wi-Fi 6, smart energy management) and assess fit for campus deployment.
¢ Develop business cases, budgets, and ROI models for smart campus initiatives.
¢ Partner with leadership to align IT infrastructure investment with institutional/organizational growth plans.
IoT & Smart Infrastructure Execution
¢ Lead design, procurement, and deployment of IoT device ecosystems across campus smart lighting, HVAC, access control, occupancy sensors, environmental monitoring, surveillance, energy metering, parking, and asset tracking.
¢ Oversee IoT platform architecture including device management, connectivity (LoRaWAN, Zigbee, BLE, Wi-Fi, cellular), edge gateways, and cloud/on-prem integration.
¢ Ensure interoperability across multi-vendor IoT systems and integration with central building management systems (BMS/BAS) and campus management platforms.
¢ Establish standards for IoT security, device provisioning, firmware lifecycle management, and data governance.
Data Center Build & Infrastructure
¢ Lead planning, design, and execution of data center build-outs (greenfield and expansion) including site selection, power and cooling design, redundancy (N+1/2N), and physical security.
¢ Manage data center infrastructure lifecycle: server/storage/network hardware, virtualization, structured cabling, UPS, generators, and environmental monitoring systems.
¢ Ensure compliance with relevant standards (TIA-942, Uptime Institute Tier standards, ISO 27001) and local regulatory requirements.
¢ Drive capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategy for campus data infrastructure.
Program & Vendor Management
¢ Manage full project lifecycle: scoping, RFPs, vendor evaluation, contract negotiation, implementation, and handover to operations.
¢ Own budgets, timelines, and delivery quality across concurrent smart campus and infrastructure projects.
¢ Build and manage relationships with OEMs, system integrators, telecom providers, and consultants.
¢ Establish SLAs and governance frameworks for ongoing operations and maintenance.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
¢ Build, mentor, and lead a multidisciplinary team spanning network engineering, IoT/embedded systems, data center operations, and project management.
¢ Act as the key liaison between IT, facilities, security, academic/business units, and executive leadership.
¢ Present roadmaps, project status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and governance committees.
¢ Drive change management and user adoption for new smart campus systems.
Governance, Security & Compliance
¢ Ensure infrastructure design adheres to cybersecurity best practices, including network segmentation for OT/IoT environments.
¢ Own risk assessment, audit readiness, and compliance documentation for infrastructure projects.
¢ Establish monitoring, incident response, and maintenance protocols for critical infrastructure.
Required Qualifications
¢ Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field (Master's/MBA preferred).
¢ 1218+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing smart campus, smart building, or large-scale IoT deployments.
¢ Demonstrated experience leading data center build projects from design through commissioning.
¢ Strong understanding of IoT architectures, protocols, and platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub, or equivalent).
¢ Experience with structured cabling, LAN/WAN design, wireless infrastructure, and data center facilities (power, cooling, redundancy).
¢ Proven track record managing multi-crore/multi-million-dollar infrastructure budgets and large vendor ecosystems.
¢ Familiarity with BMS/BAS integration, physical security systems, and energy management platforms.
¢ Strong project management skills (PMP/PRINCE2 certification preferred).
Preferred Qualifications
¢ Certifications such as CDCP/CDCS (Data Center), CCNP/CCIE, or IoT-specific certifications.
¢ Experience in campus environments (corporate, educational institution, or industrial park).
¢ Exposure to sustainability/green building initiatives (LEED, IGBC) and smart energy systems.
¢ Working knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks for OT/IoT (NIST, ISO 27001).
Key Competencies
¢ Strategic thinking with hands-on execution capability
¢ Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
¢ Vendor negotiation and contract management
¢ Cross-functional team leadership
¢ Problem-solving under complex, multi-vendor technical environments
¢ Budget ownership and financial acumen

 Address:  205, Amrakunj Avis, Near Tapovan Circle, Above Gwalbhog Restaurant, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424
